title: Heading of Settings › Performance: a tool that records how fast the app responds in this browser tab, for a bug report. Technical, plain tone.
intro: "The slow action" is whatever felt slow to the person. "A sample" is one recording.
privacy: What the downloaded report contains and doesn't. "URL parameters" are the parts of web addresses after "?".
status: The recorder's status and how many measurements (entries) it holds. Base form: stopped; _recording: recording now.
start: Button on Settings › Performance: starts recording how fast the app responds in this tab.
stop: Button: stops the recording; the report can then be downloaded.
download: Button: save the recording as a JSON file.
